title: Qigdu reedah essero
intro: dumaahi dabaanal, caylale num fidin baaxo kee tet sigeenit amoytinuh ugte. ta muucih doolat asta luk sugte kaxxa kaxxiinaa kee qibaadah reedal kaxxa gexkalit luk sugte. ellecabo sarrimaane inkih tan horaarih sarrimaane le baritto tekkeh tan roocih kinnaane yaybulleenimih gulgulus.
clues: Anu yi qangara madqak sugteh tan caylale saltaneet amol reeda luk suge.
Anu inni xiinissoh gubat yan marak inkih qibaadah esserak, daga raqta rabbi kinniyom warseh.
Anu baxsale ayyunta xukkuteh, ken naqoosa kee ken lab xaylo qidoonuh amriseh.
Anu qagaaqagitak yoo kee yi baab abeynit foocal qado maxiqa abeh yan Yallih farmoytit yoo garaye.
Anu giddiliinol numma cineh, farmoyti baab kee kaa kee kay kataysis baysoonuh ekraariseh.
Yoo kee yi qande inkih baddi addat culneh sugne, yi gabat currik yewqeh yan mara cabsu sinnim kattaatak sugne.
arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
